entries.en: Network commands like curl are now available for Claude to use
entries.zh: 现在 Claude 可以使用 curl 等网络命令

entries.en: Claude can now run multiple web queries in parallel
entries.zh: Claude 现在可以并行运行多个 Web 查询

entries.en: Pressing ESC once immediately interrupts Claude in Auto-accept mode
entries.zh: 在自动接受模式下，按一次 ESC 即可立即打断 Claude
